## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive — internal rotation with Technology under pressure while Consumer Staples, Industrials and Materials show strength. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); confirmations include multiple large-cap Tech names BELOW TREND (MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND) and heavyweight Consumer Staples/Industrials ABOVE TREND (PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leading: VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, CL (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.65%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials: FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, UPS (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -13.10% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -24.87% | 1M: -33.29%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: mixed with defensive staples and cyclicals favored.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMAT (1W: -10.94% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -27.74%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.08% | 1M: -31.03%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -13.10% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -13.53% | 1M: -32.68%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: VZ (1W: +18.31%), CHTR (1W: +16.71%), FDX (1W: +13.76%), PEP (1W: +12.67%), DOW (1W: +12.67%) — watch NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND where bullish news (+60) is diverging from price, indicating distribution rather than confirmed accumulation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology shows broad weakness: sector 1W: -7.84% | 1M: -8.91% (19 stocks) with major names below trend — MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +5.38%) CORRECTION; this is a significant divergence and warrants monitoring for further trend breaks.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft 1W: -0.79% | 1M: -4.27% (20 stocks); JPM (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -4.76%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND — no broad Financial leadership, so style is mixed / no clear leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare modestly positive 1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.66% (15 stocks); JNJ (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.11%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND — defensive names showing strength while select biotech/insurer names lag.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Consumer Staples, Industrials and Materials exposure (PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to high-multiple Technology names that are BELOW TREND (MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical and defensive staples preferred in this CAUTION regime.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND on ENFLONSIA approval; PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND after target lift. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples, Industrials, Materials (breadth and top names ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology and Consumer Discretionary (broad weakness in major caps), Financials to monitor for follow-through in RECOVERY names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA — failure to reclaim last week's losses would signal continuation of the BELOW TREND move; AAPL (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND — sustaining weekly gains would support rotation into Growth; JPM (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY — follow-through above recent 1W highs would confirm reversal; PEP — hold above this week's gap to confirm continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MRK (+80): ENFLONSIA approval — price confirming as MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND (confirming). NVDA (+60): reports of OpenAI investment — price diverging as NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND (distribution signal). CL (+60): margin expansion guidance — CL (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.65%) ABOVE TREND (confirming).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
EL (-80): heavy negative headlines and EL (1W: -16.10% | 1M: -10.95%) BELOW TREND (confirming). UNH (-70): DOJ probe headlines and UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND (confirming). AMZN (-55): earnings weakness and AMZN (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND (confirming).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical and defensive tilt. PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND and FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is the large-cap Tech divergence — MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND despite positive NVDA news (+60) — watch for trend breaks.
